description.shortText: Using IoT, Smart Rooms allow for a full control of the room without the need for human intervention. Guests have the option to control the room such as switching on/off the AC, control the temperature, smart speaker, as well as monitoring the performance of electronic devices remotely, providing hotel staff with live information about their operating status.
